content: {"like":["Enjoys films with strong atmosphere and mystery, especially those with a retro or classic vibe; appreciates high-quality remasters and restoration work; values authenticity and passion in documentary storytelling; likes quirky or unconventional character designs; enjoys immersive, fun viewing experiences without overemphasis on plot."],"dislike":["Dislikes poorly executed special effects or low-quality transfers; rejects films with weak or nonsensical plots and plot holes; finds bad dialogue, acting, or comedic elements off-putting; is critical of films that rely on corny horror tropes or weak music; avoids content that feels deceptive or misleading in marketing."]}
